title: A hypothetical review lead-time model
method: Planning example: initial preparation 3 + waiting 4 + resolution 1 = 8 days; revised 1 + 2 + 1 = 4 days. Inputs are invented, not observed productivity gains; decision complexity is assumed unchanged.
alt: A hypothetical review lead-time model. Meeting-led workflow: 8 days; Focused asynchronous review: 4 days. Illustrative inputs.
